value.rationale: A graph- and payoff-natural two-action learning model admits a complete all-size equilibrium-and-convergence classification, sharp weighted global contraction rate, and explicit critical t^-1/2 slowdown constant. The J sqrt(ab)/2 threshold exposes the geometric part-size effect missed by maximum-degree sufficient bounds and distinguishes population heterogeneity. Critical relaxation quantifies convergence time near a sharp learning phase boundary, not merely a static known mean-field reduction.
